newsitem.title: FINLAND: RAISIO FALLS SHARPLY IN ACTIVE TRADE.
newsitem.headline: RAISIO FALLS SHARPLY IN ACTIVE TRADE.

text.p: Shares in Finnish food, feed and chemicals group Raisio Yhtyma Oy fell sharply in lively trade on Thursday with sellers clearly outnumbering buyers, adding to recent volatility, brokers said.
At 1620/1320 GMT Raisio traded at 352.00 markka, down 26.00 markka or almost seven percent, in quite lively 25 million markka dealings.
"There are more sellers than buyers," one broker said.
Brokers and analysts said some investors had apparently grown tired of waiting for results from Raisio's Benecol margarine business, for which Raisio has been seeking an overseas partner.
"Some people are running out of patience," one broker said.
